name: Dave & Buster's
outlook:
What Dave & Buster's says to expect

  • Rest of fiscal 2026: store remodelsThe Company expects to complete two additional Dave & Buster’s store remodels during the remainder of fiscal 2026, bringing the total number of remodels completed in fiscal 2026 to eight.
  • Rest of fiscal 2026: international franchise storesThe Company has six international franchise stores and expects to open at least one additional international franchise store during the remainder of fiscal 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed September 14, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
